policy.rationale: Require retained evidence and independent review before a later release decision.

rules.rationale: A later high-risk decision requires two independent reviewers.
The evaluated bundle must be the exact retained build artifact.
The retained candidate comparison must not contain regression errors.
The comparison must preserve at least ninety-five percent paired coverage.
The exact policy-independent safety assessment must remain eligible.
The retained replay must contain no uncertain side-effect event.
The retained Wilson lower bound must be at least ninety percent.
